thread:
olivia: quick check 16 we're debating internal API shape for inference: proto/gRPC for services + a browser-friendly REST streaming surface, or stick with REST everywhere? thoughts?
tao: proto-first for internal S2S, definitely. gives us stable schemas and smaller wire. but browsers and some partners force us to support fetch/json and SSE.
ben: agree. big question is where quotas & billing counters live. runtime knows token counts, gateway knows incoming rate. we should have a split model: gateway enforces rate limits, runtime emits final token metrics for billing. gateway writes a lightweight pre-claim for quota.
anna: for telemetry we must be able to trace a request across gateway -> runtime and show in console which surface served it. recommend header passthrough: X-RW-Tenant, X-RW-Route, X-RW-Surface, X-RW-Model-Version, X-RW-Trace. gateway should add X-RW-Surface=rest|grpc and X-RW-Transcode=1 for translated calls.
olivia: streaming mapping detail: Envoy+transcoder struggles with real-time gRPC streams. proposal: gateway proxies gRPC streams as chunked HTTP with newline-delimited JSON frames. mark frames with a type field: {"t":"data","payload":...} and include a final {"t":"eof"}.
tao: DSL idea for routing policy (pseudo):
```
route "infer.v3" {
  match: POST /v3/infer
  prefer: grpc://inference/v3.Infer/Run
  fallback: http://internal/v3/infer
  streaming: chunked-json
  quotas: { tenant_tokens_per_min: 1500 }
  telemetry: [route, tenant, model, surface]
}
```
ben: console UX must show "served_by" per request and a token breakdown: input.tokens, output.tokens, total.tokens, cost_estimate. Also expose transcoding_failure counts separately so we can detect silent losses.
anna: schema evolution: generate JSON Schema from protos and publish in schema-registry. console uses registry to validate REST requests client-side and show helpful errors.
olivia: canary plan: gateway supports per-route canary percent and a toggle to disable translation so we can test direct grpc vs translated rest. console should show live canary %, recent error rates per-surface, and latency delta.
tao: risk list: repeated fields and Any<>JSON conversion, binary blobs, streaming order guarantees. We need a test-suite with fuzzed proto messages to ensure deterministic transcoding.
ben: quick perf checklist for spike: 1) measure median latency gateway->grpc vs direct grpc 2) memory/CPU overhead of chunked-json adapter 3) percent of requests that need fallback to rest path 4) failure modes in transcoding
anna: I'll own the telemetry story and add metrics names: rw.tokens.{tenant}.{model}, rw.requests.{route}.{surface}, rw.errors.{route}.{errtype}. Make sure runtime emits token granularity so billing is accurate.
ci-bot: ticket created: infra/spikes/1767001111-transcode-proxy-spike (CI pipeline + perf job) :gear: 
olivia: TL;DR plan: 1) define protos for Infer.v3 2) add runtime token hooks 3) build gateway chunked-json proxy for streaming 4) auto-gen JSON schemas + registry 5) console canary + surface panels 6) tests for transcoding edge cases.
tao: can take the gateway spike, will post POC with curl examples and perf numbers by EOD Tuesday.
ben: please include a tiny console mock showing a request timeline and which layer enforced quota vs billed.
anna: noted, will include mock and metric examples.
olivia: great, thanks all. keep follow-ups in-thread. :thumbsup:
